text: Adds fiat-to-crypto payments, KYC, and compliance to a product without building it in-house
quote: MoonPay lets you add fiat-to-crypto to your product without rebuilding payments, KYC, and compliance.

text: Hosted on-ramp/off-ramp widget that can be embedded in an app, with MoonPay handling KYC, payments, and UI
quote: A hosted on-ramp and off-ramp you embed in your app. MoonPay runs the KYC, payments, and UI.

text: Headless APIs/SDKs to build a fully custom on-ramp/off-ramp UI on MoonPay's rails
quote: Build your own on-ramp and off-ramp on MoonPay's APIs and SDKs. Your UI, your flow, our rails.

text: Existing MoonPay users can be connected to a new integration without re-onboarding
quote: Connect existing MoonPay usersSkip re-onboarding. Plug into the existing MoonPay account base.

text: Co-branded, embeddable payment and onboarding UI frames built on top of headless APIs
quote: Embed payment and onboarding framesCo-branded UI components on top of headless APIs.

text: Docs expose an MCP server so AI agents can search and retrieve documentation content directly
quote: The documentation includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents direct access to search and retrieve content.

text: Public GitHub repo of cloneable demo integrations that work once API keys are added
quote: The MoonPay Demo Integrations GitHub repository has working, clone-able example integrations ready to use - just add your API keys.

text: Widget can be branded with custom colors, logo, and logo on transactional emails
quote: You can customize the widget to feel like a native part of your site or application by adjusting button and background colors. You can also add your company logo to the transactional emails sent to customers.

text: Checkout flow can be pre-filled with wallet address, email, token, currency, amount, and payment method to speed conversion
quote: Improve your customers' experience and speed up the buying process by pre-filling information such as their wallet address, email, selected token, fiat currency, amounts, and their preferred payment method.

text: Can auto-create a wallet for users using just their email address during the purchase flow
quote: Users don't have a digital wallet? We can create one for them using just their email address as they go through the purchase flow.

text: Sends webhook events to notify an application of account activity
quote: MoonPay can send webhook events that notify your application whenever an activity occurs on your account.

text: Specific webhook (sell_transaction_requote_required) lets apps surface in-app requote notices when sell price changes
quote: Handle the sell_transaction_requote_required webhook to surface in-app requote notifications when a sell price changes.

text: Test mode using testnet chains and simulated payments for integration testing with no real assets moved
quote: MoonPay provides a test mode for integration development and testing. Test mode uses testnet blockchains and simulated payments. No real assets are transferred.

text: API endpoint builds a fiat-to-crypto buy quote with locked rate, fees, and execution signature
quote: Builds a quote for a fiat-to-crypto buy. Returns locked rate, fees, and signature for payment execution.

text: Session token creation endpoint used to initialize a connection for integration
quote: Create a session token to initialize a connection

text: Users can buy crypto with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfers, or wires
quote: Use a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay to buy crypto fast. We also accept bank transfers and wires.

text: Off-ramp converts crypto to cash paid out to bank account or Visa card
quote: Turn your crypto into cash. In a flash. Get paid straight to your bank account or Visa card.

text: Supports token swaps across different blockchains with seamless bridging
quote: Trade between tokens, even if they're on different chains (we make bridging seamless too).

text: Guest checkout lets new customers buy crypto via Apple Pay/Google Pay without creating a MoonPay account
quote: Let new customers buy crypto with Apple Pay or Google Pay without a MoonPay account.

text: Large existing user base has stored payment and KYC details, improving conversion for repeat purchases
quote: Millions of users have previously purchased cryptocurrencies using MoonPay, having stored their payment and KYC details, leading to maximized conversion rates.
